purpose: Fresh-seed CPU coverage and finite-sample qualification of two binary endpoints only; no production gate promotion.
method: One-sided exact binomial upper bound on paired discordance. Absolute mean difference <= discordance probability. Bonferroni alpha over all 32 predeclared comparisons. Independent primary pairs, fixed N, no optional stopping or pilot reuse. Missing groups stay unresolved.
exclusions: Hard-count and continuous-mean equivalence remain outside this binary-endpoint qualification. Existing frozen pilot rules and production gates unchanged. #795 is not included; completion remains the measured scalar implementation.
